description: Closed-hem flat-pattern golden for an AUTHORED plate + one CLOSED HEM (docs/design/sheet-metal-parity.md §2 Hem row / Parity roadmap #3; docs/design/sheet-metal.md §1/§4.2/§9). A closed hem folds the picked edge ~180 deg back FLAT onto the parent face with a small inner radius (a specialization of the shipped edge flange at bend_angle=180). Rebuilt from a real feature tree (sketch -> sheet_metal_base_flange -> sheet_metal_hem), tagged with a CylindricalFaceSignature at construction, and found back by that signature (never blind detection). Proves the near-flat 180-deg fold produces ONE clean valid solid and develops correctly (BA = pi*(r + K*t)), i.e. the closed hem reuses the edge-flange bend + unfold machinery verbatim.
tangent_line_convention: Flat length is measured to the bend TANGENT LINES (§9 #1). The base flange's developed leg is the full length of its flat top face (50 mm, from the far edge to the bend tangent line at the hemmed edge); the hem return's developed leg is its own flat face length (15 mm). The bend allowance BA REPLACES the two setback segments a sharp-corner unfold would use. A closed hem is a 180-deg fold, so the developed strip is the SAME kind of BA strip any bend produces; its bend-table row reads angle 180 deg.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill). Dims: base flange 50 x 20 mm (developed leg 50, width 20), hem return developed leg 15 mm, gauge t = 2 mm, hem inner bend radius r = 1 mm (a tight closed hem, ~0.5*t; the layers' air gap is ~2*r = 2 mm), fold angle 180 deg = pi, K = 0.44 (v1 default).

Bend allowance (§1): BA = angle_rad * (r + K*t) = pi * (1 + 0.44*2) = pi * 1.88 = 5.9061941887488105 mm. Unlike the 90-deg L-bracket golden the resolved inner radius is EXACTLY 1.0 (no arc-fit FP noise at this radius on build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9), so BA matches the closed form to full float precision.
Flat length (§9 #1): flat_length = base_leg + BA + hem_leg = 50 + 5.9061941887488105 + 15 = 70.90619418874881 mm. Measured == analytic (residual 0.0).

Developed area (§9 #2, neutral-surface conservation): flat_area = base_area + hem_area + BA*width = (50*20) + (15*20) + (5.9061941887488105*20) = 1000 + 300 + 118.12388... = 1418.123883774976 mm^2. Equivalently flat_length * width = 70.90619418874881 * 20 (the blank is a rectangle).

Fold direction is inferred from the geometry (§5): the hem return folds to the +normal side of the base flange, so direction = 'up'. Fold angle = 180 deg exactly (the return's flat face normal is anti-parallel to the base's -> dot -1.0 -> acos = pi to full precision).

Fused body volume = base plate (50*20*2 = 2000) + hem return (cross-section 15*2 + half-annulus (pi/2)((r+t)^2 - r^2) = (pi/2)((3)^2 - (1)^2) = (pi/2)*8 = 4*pi = 12.566370614359172; cross-section = 30 + 4*pi = 42.56637..., * 20 width = 851.3274122871834) = 2851.3274122871835 mm^3 (analytic). The return sits 2*r = 2 mm above the base with an air gap, so the fold-back does NOT self-intersect (verified valid down to r = 1e-6).

content_hash is the sha256 of the provenance-driven FlatPattern.to_json_bytes(). It is a DETERMINISM PIN (byte-identity), not analytic -- reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4). Version-pinned like the STEP/PDF export goldens: a change WITHOUT a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill). The bend allowance is a four-term closed form and the developed legs are exact OCCT face extents. Measured deviations vs the hand-derived values (2026-07-19, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): flat_length residual 0.0, flat_area residual 0.0, BA residual 0.0 (the r=1 mm inner arc resolves EXACTLY, unlike the r=3 mm L-bracket's 2.9999999999999933). Documented ceiling 1e-9 gives ample headroom for platform FP variation while staying tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). The volume tolerance (1e-6) absorbs arc-fit noise scaled by the 20 mm width (measured residual ~9e-13).
